recentItems.title: Benny Blanco On the Moment He Knew Selena Gomez Was 'The One' | Open Book with Jenna
recentItems.description:
Benny Blanco sits down with Jenna Bush Hager for a candid conversation about love, failure, fear and finding the courage to go after what you want. Benny shares the unforgettable story of the night he realized Selena Gomez was the person he wanted to marry, plus the simple qualities he was looking for in a partner. He also talks about his new book, why failure is essential to success, overcoming fear and the importance of putting yourself out there.

recentItems.title: Kit Harington on ‘A Tale of Two Cities,’ ‘Harry Potter,’ NY Knicks
recentItems.description:
Kit Harington stops by TODAY to talk about starring in and executive producing the new mini-series adaptation of Charles Dickens’ novel “A Tale of Two Cities.” He shares what drew him to the project, saying, “This has not been done as much, and I think it’s one of [Dicken’s] most propulsive, iconic, exciting, prescient pieces.” He also talks about his upcoming role as Professor Lockhart in HBO’s “Harry Potter” series, and becoming a Knicks fan this summer.

recentItems.title: Benny Blanco on his Spanish-Language Album ‘Hermoso’
recentItems.description:
"For me, it’s (about) always keeping things fresh and exciting."

Benny Blanco talks about making a Spanish-language album, "Hermoso," featuring Latino artists like Becky G and his wife Selena Gomez, his love for reggaeton, and shares appreciation for the opportunities to make Latin records throughout his career.

recentItems.title: New 72 MPH ‘Fast & Furious’ Rollercoaster Opens at Universal
recentItems.description:
After a decade in the making, the “Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift” rollercoaster at Universal Studios in Hollywood is officially open! Inspired by the blockbuster movies, the rollercoaster is a “technological first,” with cars launching at up to 72 miles per hour and zooming past those waiting in line. Reporting for TODAY, NBC's Gadi Schwartz buckles up and takes the ride for a spin.

recentItems.title: TODAY Anchors Receive Flu Vaccine Shots Live in Studio 1A
recentItems.description:

CVS pharmacists stop by TODAY to show how quick and easy it is. NBC medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar also joins to break down everything you need to know about this year’s flu season.
